basic_info.description: On a prized block in the heart of Bernal Heights, this beautiful Edwardian home is flooded with light from its expansive windows and skylights.  The home has been thoughtfully updated for modern living while retaining its charming period details. The newly-remodeled chef's kitchen is handsomely appointed with stainless steel appliances, quartz counters and ample cabinetry. Offering the ultimate in indoor/outdoor living, the kitchen opens onto an expansive walk-out deck for dining under Bernal's sunny skies. The spacious formal dining room is ideal for entertaining.  On the upper level, there are two expansive bedrooms boasting hardwood floors and generous closets.  These bedrooms are served by a bright, skylit bath with a deep jetted tub.  The primary bedroom offers lovely views of the bay and the tranquil garden.  An additional bedroom and skylit bath on the entry level are ideal for guests or a nanny.   The lush, private  garden and  flagstone patio offer a tranquil retreat.  This lovely home is completed by a convenient laundry, generous garage and abundant storage.  You'll love the convenience of being so close to Bernal Heights Park and the shops and restaurants of Cortland Avenue!
